matt: Heads-up: us-west1-gpu pool showing PCIe reset spike. 12 resets in last 60m, 3 nodes reporting Xid=31 followed by driver reset. Jobs seeing transient OOMs. Anyone oncall?

sabrina: On it. Looks like nvme firmware rollout hit those racks yesterday — correlating logs now.

alexa: I can flip soft-cordon policy to err on side of safety. Proposed flow: >2 resets in 15m -> add taint key=pcie-reset:soft, effect=NoSchedule; >4 resets in 30m -> full cordon + drain (graceful) + create incident.

matt: Agree. For drain logic, avoid preempting high-priority DGX batch runs. Use pod annotation role=gpu-critical to skip eviction.

infra-bot: gpu-healthwatch alert: node gpu-uw1-23 pcie_resets=3 (last_15m). Action: triggered soft-taint.

sabrina: Pushing k8s snippet to runbook: ```kubectl taint nodes gpu-uw1-23 pcie-reset=soft:NoSchedule``` 
```kubectl drain gpu-uw1-23 --pod-selector='role!=gpu-critical' --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300```

alexa: Add fallback: if drain fails (pods stuck >10m) then mark node for manual remediation and spin up replacement from spare capacity pool. Also add slack alert to #eng-infra with @oncall-rotation mention.

matt: We should also update Slurm flow: `scontrol update NodeName=gpu-uw1-23 State=DRAIN Reason="pcie-reset"` and `scontrol requeue` for preemptible jobs.

sabrina: Cost note: spinning replacements will dip into burst reserve; we have budget for ~10 replacements/month before Dedicated overage. I'll add budget guardrail in the autoscaler.

alexa: Automation outline: healthwatch -> classifier (pcie_reset rate) -> orchestration svc calls kube/slurm via service account -> upsert node metadata + wait windows -> escalate -> uncordon after 60m no-resets.

matt: Test plan: simulate pcie reset by injecting metric to healthwatch test topic (rather than messing with hardware). Schedule a dry run at 03:00 UTC.

infra-bot: Dry-run scheduled by sabrina for 03:00 UTC in us-west1. Will post results in thread.

sabrina: :thumbsup: I'll roll the change into staging runbook and follow up with PR for automation.

oncall-rotation: If this starts happening in multiple regions, prefer cross-region routing and avoiding full scale up where possible — cost + latency tradeoffs.

matt: Agreed. For now prioritizing graceful softdrain + auto-untaint (60m window). Thanks team.
